what: The collection window priced end to end on the two ledger rungs that can be priced, at equal relation yield. Collection is 97.8 percent of the whole pipeline and the rungs scan the entire factor base per probe; a window scans a rotating slice of it.
why: The previous round established that collection dominates every other phase by two orders of magnitude. The window mechanism already exists and most other parameter files use one, but the three ledger rungs do not, so they pay the full scan's redundancy on the phase that holds the cost.
mechanism: A full m = 3 scan encounters each triple three times -- once for each summand that can be the third -- and keeps one sorted witness, discarding two. A window of w keeps all three chances at w/|F| of the scan, so relations per summand scanned rise towards three times the full scan's. The window offset is rotated per trial from a hash of (seed, trial), so no column is favoured by sitting where the window starts.

boundaries.floor: generic-group floor S = sqrt(pi/2A), A = 2n; unmoved, the window changes no count it bounds
boundaries.count_floor: the contract's bound is on ATTEMPTS: expected attempts >= R_req / min(1, C(|F|+m-1,m)/N). The window does not improve this and makes it worse -- it uses more trials per relation, not fewer. What falls is summand scans, which that floor does not bound.
boundaries.reference: Pollard rho, signed-Frobenius, counted on the same instance in the same process

unit: batched group addition; build and rho native, probes and the linear algebra converted by factors measured at each rung's own degree
controlled: Same curve, same subgroup, same factor-base spec and seed, same targets, same summand counts, same descent. Only the collection window and the trial count sized to match the relation yield differ.
finding: About 2.7x fewer whole-pipeline operations at both priced rungs: 2.715x at degree 53 and 2.696x at degree 41, with an independent holdout target set giving 2.762x. Monotone in the window at degree 53 over 1908, 954, 477. S falls from 4.2069 to 1.5497 at degree 53 and from 1.4918 to 0.5533 at degree 41, which is 3.24x rho -- the closest this pipeline has measured.

classification.why: S fell by 2.7x and the ratio to the stated count floor did not fall -- it rose, because the window spends more attempts per relation while scanning far less. The window finds no decomposition the full scan could not; it stops the full scan discarding two of every three it finds. AGENTS.md section 3: legitimate, bounded, and not a finding.

a_correction_inside_this_round: The first breadth pass sized each window to spend the SAME summand scans as the baseline rather than to collect the same relations. Every window then over-collected -- 1652 and 1735 relations against the 458 needed at degree 53, and 361 against 124 at degree 41 -- and the totals came out 0.63x and 1.00x. The yield per scan had risen everywhere, exactly as the mechanism predicts, but a gain in yield is not a gain in cost until the trials are reduced to bank it. The rows above are all re-sized to equal relations.
not_claimed: A scaling law. Two degrees with one sized window each, plus a three-point window sweep at one of them, is not four sizes and no exponent is fitted.
That 477 is the optimum. It is the best of three measured at degree 53 and the sweep at constant scans turned over by 238, so the optimum is near |F|/32; it was not searched finely.
Anything about the k0n31 rung, whose m = 3 scan saturates and cannot be priced.
A new capability. The window mechanism already existed and most other parameter files use one; what this measures is that the ledger rungs do not.
an_open_question_for_the_repository: Whether the frozen ledger rungs should adopt a window. They are the regression baseline, and changing their parameters changes what the gate measures and breaks comparability with references v1 through v4. Left unchanged here; the windowed variants are separate parameter files beside them.

harness.runs: ic workflow on the parameter files named in each row
harness.correctness: 32 of 32 targets recovered and verified as [d]G = Q on every row, every column covered, zero relations rejected
